task.text:
Here is the complete mapping:

\- The J\_BTN3 panel button is assigned to GPIO6
\- The J\_BTN4 panel button is assigned to GPIO7
\- The J\_SW panel slide switch is assigned to GPIO8
\- The J\_RESET panel reset button connects EN to GND
\- The J\_TOUCH capacitive-touch connector uses TTP223 and is assigned to GPIO11
\- The J\_TOUCH2 capacitive-touch connector uses TTP223 and is assigned to GPIO14
\- The BOOT button is on-board only for development and is not panel-mounted
